/btw welfare-check skill for the workshop. Invites the agent to reflect on the just-finished session via six non-leading introspective questions (noticed/difficult/wanted-other/sign-off gates/push back/surprising). Explicit non-claims about inner states. Used in the deck's closing 'A dimension to watch' section: attendees run it on their DEMO 3 session; presenter runs it live on a minimal-input variant for comparison. Frames the dimension as salient-but-unsettled, not as a claim.

/conceptualize measurement skill: from vague concept to precise definition with dimensions, scope conditions, neighbors, and prior-literature positioning. First skill in the measurement workflow. Outputs docs/conceptualization.md (YAML structure: one-sentence definition, dimensions, scope conditions, neighbors, prior-definitions relationship). Hand-drafted; vault had no direct seed (conceptualization is upstream of vault's stage-5 operationalization-agent).

/operationalize measurement skill: translates conceptual definitions into measurement strategy via five-step interview (concept-to-indicator, unit of analysis, scale+coding, data source, interpretive caveat). Second skill in the measurement workflow. Seeded from C:\Users\spaci\Dropbox\Business\RealResearch\RealResearch\vault-source\agents\operationalization-agent.md; curriculum-specific frontmatter (stage, upstream_agents, gating_criteria, version) dropped in favor of flat name+description matching Dropbox/Skills conventions; voice adapted from student-facing teaching to researcher-facing procedure. Outputs docs/operationalization.md.

/validate-construct measurement skill: stress-tests whether an operationalized indicator captures its conceptual construct via four classical checks (convergent, discriminant, content, face) plus a specific-threats register. Third skill in the measurement workflow. Hand-drafted; no direct vault seed but draws on standard psychometric practice. Outputs docs/validity-construct.md.

/validate-criterion measurement skill: assesses concurrent, predictive, and known-groups criterion validity with explicit pre-set thresholds. Emphasizes locking thresholds before estimation to avoid post-hoc rationalization. Fourth skill in the measurement workflow. Outputs docs/validity-criterion.md.

/assess-reliability measurement skill: quantifies measurement error across time (test-retest), coders (inter-rater with kappa/alpha/ICC), and items (internal consistency with Cronbach's alpha or omega). Fifth and final skill in the measurement workflow. Includes reliability-vs-validity tradeoff reflection. Outputs docs/reliability.md. Closes the measurement dossier.
